# CCB — docs for LLMs / AI agents
# Human docs (English) live in docs/. These files are the Chinese
# versions of the same docs, for LLM/agent consumption.
# The single English spec is requirement.md at the repo root;
# it is intentionally not translated.

- [README](docs/llm/README.md): Layout of the LLM docs and how they map to the English human docs.
- [Build pipeline](docs/llm/build.md): Build stages, caching, reproducible builds, kotlinc daemon, static release binary, running the tests.
- [Toolchain setup](docs/llm/setup.md): Toolchain provisioning via ccb setup, JDK/kotlinc/NDK/r8 installs, host tools, proxy limitation, custom tool paths.
- [Remote Maven dependencies](docs/llm/maven.md): Declaring Maven coordinates, transitive resolution, cache and checksums, lockfile, limitations, troubleshooting.
- [Library modules](docs/llm/modules.md): Declaring library modules, graph rules, build flow, R semantics, incremental builds, limitations.
- [Preview](docs/llm/preview.md): The ccb preview UI convention — flow files, click handlers, real code, scenarios, traces, styles, layout model, lint diagnostics, output modes, build gate, diff, walk, watch, LSP server.
- [Diagnostic codes](docs/llm/diagnostics.md): Full catalog of CCB-E, CCB-P diagnostic codes and exit codes.
- [JSON protocol](docs/llm/json-protocol.md): The --json event stream, --explain and --dry-run.
- [Connecting a device](docs/llm/device-setup.md): Wireless debugging over Tailscale, adb safety, behavior with no device attached.
